answer.reason: The 10-Q names the Helsinn v. Teva palonosetron case and says Teva may have to cease sales or pay damages, but gives no damages figure (only Aloxi U.S. annual sales of $459 million, which is not a stated consequence of the ruling); the ruling affirmed Teva's win, and a single generic IV product is peripheral to Teva's $35.8bn core business.
